```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
set.seed(123)
```

```{r}
# Define functions
ppv <- function(se, sp, p){ # se = sensitivity, sp = specificity, p = disease prevalence
  value <- (se * p) / (se * p + ((1 - sp) * (1 - p)))
  return(value) 
}

npv <- function(se, sp, p){
  value <- (sp * (1 - p)) / ((1 - se) * p + sp * (1 - p))
  return (value)
}

# Expected utility
EU <- function(pv, u_t, u_f){   # pv = (PPV OR NPV), u_t = (U_TP OR U_TN), u_f = (U_FP OR U_FN)
  return (pv*u_t + (1-pv)*u_f)
}

# QALY function
qaly <- function(x, tat, u_s0, eu){
  return (tat*u_s0 + (x-tat)*eu)
}
```

```{r}
# Simulate parameters
n <- 400

# Diagnostic yields
cma_yield <- rbeta(n, 154,1382) # CMA yield
gp_yield <- rbeta(n, 234, 1871)  # gene-panel yield
es_yield_1tier <- rbeta(n, 27, 46)  # WES first-tier yield (mean 0.37)
es_yield_3tier <- rbeta(n, 228, 464) # WES third-tier yield (mean 0.33)
es_yield_2tier <- rbeta(n, 35, 65) # The yield of WES as second-tier test is slightly lower than first-tier but higher than third-tier

# Costs
expert_fee <- 165 # cost at decision node
es_cost <- rnorm(n, 4589.4, 45) # cost of WES
cma_cost <- rgamma(n, 2010, 2.44) # cost of CMA
gp_cost <- rlnorm(n, log(400), 0.8213) # cost of gene-panel

# Sensitivity & Specificity
cma_se <- 0.9068
cma_sp <- 0.9440
gp_se <- 0.8960
gp_sp <- 0.9250
es_se <- 0.9593
es_sp <- 0.9933

#Disease prevalence
p <- 0.1665

# PPV & NPV
cma_ppv <- ppv(cma_se, cma_sp, p)
cma_npv <- npv(cma_se, cma_sp, p)
gp_ppv <- ppv(gp_se, gp_sp, p)
gp_npv <- npv(gp_se, gp_sp, p)
es_ppv <- ppv(es_se, es_sp, p)
es_npv <- npv(es_se, es_sp, p)

# Turnaround time, measured in years
cma_tat <- (6*7)/365
cma_gp_tat <- (14*7)/365
cma_gp_es_tat <- (26*7)/365
cma_es_tat <- (18*7)/365
es_tat <- (12*7)/365
ai_tat1 <- (10*7)/365
ai_tat2 <- (18*7)/365

# AI precision, assume that it follows a beta distribution with mean 0.87 & SD 0.1
mu <- 0.87
sigma <- 0.1
a <- mu * ((mu * (1 - mu) / sigma^2) - 1)
b <- (1 - mu) * ((mu * (1 - mu) / sigma^2) - 1)
ai_precision <- rbeta(n, a, b)

# utility weight
u_tp <- rnorm(n,0.9,0.02)
u_tn <- 1
u_fp <- rnorm(n,0.8,0.02)
u_fn <- runif(n,-1,0)
u_s0 <- 0

# expected utility for different outcome states
eu_cma_pos <- EU(cma_ppv, u_tp, u_fp) # CMA, positive
eu_gp_pos <- EU(gp_ppv, u_tp, u_fp) # gene-panel, positive
eu_gp_neg <- EU(gp_npv, u_tn, u_fn) # gene-panel, negative
eu_es_pos <- EU(es_ppv, u_tp, u_fp) # ES, positive
eu_es_neg <- EU(es_npv, u_tn, u_fn) # ES, negative
```

```{r}
generate_data <- function(x) {
  
  # Scenario 1 (CMA + GP, standard testing)
  s1_cost <- cma_cost + expert_fee + (1-cma_yield)*(gp_cost + expert_fee)  #expected cost
  s1_qaly <- cma_yield*qaly(x,cma_tat,u_s0,eu_cma_pos) + (1-cma_yield)*(gp_yield*qaly(x,cma_gp_tat,u_s0,eu_gp_pos) +    (1-gp_yield)*qaly(x,cma_gp_tat,u_s0,eu_gp_neg)) #expected QALY
  s1_cpq <- s1_cost/s1_qaly # Cost per QALY
  
  # Effective cost for Scenario 2 (CMA + GP + WES)
  s2_cost <- cma_cost + expert_fee + (1-cma_yield)*(gp_cost + expert_fee + (1-gp_yield)*(es_cost + expert_fee))
  s2_qaly <- cma_yield*qaly(x,cma_tat,u_s0,eu_cma_pos) + (1-cma_yield)*(gp_yield*qaly(x,cma_gp_tat,u_s0,eu_gp_pos)   + (1-gp_yield)*es_yield_3tier*qaly(x,cma_gp_es_tat,u_s0,eu_es_pos) + (1-gp_yield)*(1-es_yield_3tier)*qaly(x,cma_gp_es_tat,u_s0,eu_es_neg))
  s2_cpq <- s2_cost/s2_qaly
  
  # Effective cost Scenario 3 (CMA + WES) CMA positive, WES pos & neg
  s3_cost <- cma_cost + expert_fee + (1-cma_yield)*(es_cost + expert_fee) 
  s3_qaly <- cma_yield*qaly(x,cma_tat,u_s0,eu_cma_pos) + (1-cma_yield)*(es_yield_2tier*qaly(x,cma_es_tat,u_s0,eu_es_pos) + (1-es_yield_2tier)*qaly(x,cma_es_tat,u_s0,eu_es_neg))
  s3_cpq <- s3_cost/s3_qaly
  
  # Effective cost for Scenario 4 (WES alone)
  s4_cost <- es_cost + expert_fee
  s4_qaly <- es_yield_1tier*qaly(x,es_tat,u_s0,eu_es_pos) + (1-es_yield_1tier)*qaly(x,es_tat,u_s0,eu_es_neg)
  s4_cpq <- s4_cost/s4_qaly
  
  # Effective cost for AI-delegation mode (r > r*)
  ai_cost <- cma_cost + expert_fee + (1-cma_yield)*(gp_cost + (1-ai_precision)*es_cost) #This is only for r > r*
  ai_qaly <- cma_yield*qaly(x,cma_tat,u_s0,eu_cma_pos) + (1-cma_yield)*ai_precision*qaly(x,ai_tat1,u_s0,eu_gp_pos) + (1-cma_yield)*(1-ai_precision)*(es_yield_3tier*qaly(x,ai_tat2,u_s0,eu_es_pos) + (1-es_yield_3tier)*qaly(x,ai_tat2,u_s0,eu_es_neg))
  ai_cpq <- ai_cost/ai_qaly
  
  complete_data <- data.frame(
    scenario = rep(c("Scenario 1 (CMA + GP)", "Scenario 2 (CMA + GP + ES)", "Scenario 3 (CMA + ES)", 
                     "Scenario 4 (ES alone)", "AI-delegation (r>r*)"), each = n),
    expected_cost = c(s1_cost, s2_cost, s3_cost, s4_cost, ai_cost),
    expected_qaly = c(s1_qaly, s2_qaly, s3_qaly, s4_qaly, ai_qaly),
    cost_per_qaly = c(s1_cpq, s2_cpq, s3_cpq, s4_cpq, ai_cpq),
    ai_performance = rep(ai_precision,5),
    number_of_years = rep(x, 5)
  )
  
  complete_data$scenario <- factor(complete_data$scenario, levels = c("Scenario 1 (CMA + GP)", "Scenario 2 (CMA + GP + ES)", 
                                                         "Scenario 3 (CMA + ES)", "Scenario 4 (ES alone)", "AI-delegation (r>r*)"))
  
  return(complete_data)
}
```

```{r}
x <- runif(n,1,10)
data <- generate_data(x)
expert_alone <- data %>% filter(scenario != "AI-delegation (r>r*)")
ai_delegation <- data %>% filter(scenario %in% c("Scenario 2 (CMA + GP + ES)", "Scenario 3 (CMA + ES)", "AI-delegation (r>r*)"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(ai_delegation, aes(x = ai_performance, y = cost_per_qaly, color = scenario)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "AI Precision", y = "Cost per QALY") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(expert_alone, aes(x = number_of_years, y = cost_per_qaly, color = scenario)) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(x = "Number of Years",
       y = "Cost per QALY") +
  theme_minimal()
```
